plan_kts:
fun plan(): Evidence {
    val taskContext = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
    val adherence = readInput(taskContext, name = "adherence")
    val mmCompliance = readInput(taskContext, name = "mm-compliance")
    val consistency = readInput(taskContext, name = "consistency")
    val security = readInput(taskContext, name = "security")
    val legs = renderLeafCells(adherence, mmCompliance, consistency, security)
    val evidence = makeEvidence(legs = legs, examined = emptyList())
    val written = writeFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", value = evidence)
    val completion = noop(message = "No action needed: consolidated preflight evidence written to /tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json.")
    return evidence
}
